transformations.description: Merges the accepted A/B/C, D/F/H, E/J, G/I, K1/K2/L and NT component scenarios. Route objects, pattern objects, StopNode objects and StopPlace objects are copied without semantic modification.
Unions identical stable municipal-code StopNode and StopPlace objects across components. A conflicting object for the same identifier is a hard build failure.
Defines elche-legacy-all-v1 as the complete discovered non-radial network: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K1, K2, L and NT. R1, R2 and R3 are deferred.
Writes scenario assets, computes asset SHA-256 values and aggregate contentHash, and registers the merged scenario.

warnings: The scenario ID uses 'all' to mean all currently approved non-radial Elche services. R1, R2 and R3 are deliberately absent.
No route, pattern, StopNode or StopPlace object was rewritten during the merge; accepted component identities remain authoritative.
Physical StopPlace identity does not create route edges, reverse patterns, or cross-pattern itinerary edges.
Runtime StopNode sourceReferences remain exactly as accepted in the source components.
